updates.title: Vote for the next map
updates.text: In Hide and Seek you can now vote for the next map during the hunt: the map card shows three maps, and the one with the most votes is played next.

updates.title: Poison in Zombie rounds
updates.text: In Hide and Seek Zombie rounds, touching poison now turns a hider into a zombie. In classic rounds poison still does nothing. Map makers can mark blocks as poison in the editor when Zombie Apocalypse is on.

updates.title: Murder Mystery and Cops & Robbers
updates.text: Murder Mystery is a new mode in the main menu: one player is secretly the murderer and takes others out with a touch, and the secret sheriff wins by catching the murderer. It starts from three players. In Hide and Seek, big rooms of six or more now sometimes play Cops & Robbers: a third of the players are cops, caught robbers freeze in place, and other robbers can free them with a touch.

updates.title: Race map rules
updates.text: Race map makers can now set lives and a time limit for their map in the editor. With limited lives, running out of them sends you back to the very start of the map (great for deathrun maps). Longer time limits of 5 or 10 minutes suit mazes, and score points scale with the map's time limit.

updates.title: Shared Race rounds
updates.text: Everyone in a Race room now runs the same map at the same time: a short countdown at the start, then a shared timer, and the next map comes when the time is up or everyone has finished. Map makers can also pick a goal for their Race map: everyone races for points, only the first to finish scores, or last one standing, where running out of lives knocks you out and the last player left wins.

updates.title: Team Battle
updates.text: Team Battle is a new mode in the main menu for two teams, Red and Blue, starting from two players. Rounds take turns between Capture the Flag and Domination on maps with hiding spots. In Capture the Flag the flags stand at the two hiding spots farthest apart: bring the enemy flag to your own to score, three points win. In Domination teams hold capture points at the hiding spots, and every point held scores each second. The team score is shown at the top, and the winning team gets coins.

updates.title: Role outfits
updates.text: Roles now have their own looks: cops wear a uniform with a cap and a badge, robbers a mask and a striped shirt, caught robbers an orange prison suit, and team players a headband in their team color. The murderer and the sheriff see their outfit only on themselves, so the roles stay secret. Flags got a proper flagpole with a waving flag, and game messages now stack neatly instead of covering each other.

updates.title: Four modes in the main menu
updates.text: The main menu now has four modes: Hide and Seek, Race, Murder Mystery and Team Battle, each with its own page, rules and room list. Until a mode has enough players, or if the map has no hiding spots for teams, its room plays classic Hide and Seek and tells you why.

updates.title: Murder Mystery, Cops & Robbers and Team Battle details
updates.text: In Murder Mystery the murderer cannot take anyone out during the first 20 seconds of the hunt, and everyone starts at a random spot on the map, so nobody can tell who is who from the start. In Cops & Robbers rounds caught robbers are sent to jail at the seeker spot of the map, and other robbers have to break in to free them. Team Battle now plays with four teams, Red, Blue, Green and Yellow, when there are 8 or more players on maps with at least four hiding spots.

updates.title: War mode, tokens and the shop
updates.text: War is a new mode in the main menu with fists, slings, bombs and magic. Rounds take turns: Free for All, Team War with two or four teams, Hunger Games with one life, Control Points and Bro RED, where one huge red fighter takes on everyone. Press F or click to attack, 1-4 to switch weapons, B for the shop; on a phone there is a red attack button. Tokens now lie around the map in War and Hide and Seek: spend them in the shop on ammo, a medkit or a shield in War, or on speed, a super jump, invisibility for hiders and a radar for the seeker in Hide and Seek.

updates.title: Pirate War and cannons
updates.text: War rooms now have a Pirate War round on maps with cannons: two teams on two ships fire poison cannonballs where they aim, and knocking someone into the poison water counts as your knockout. A new Pirate Bay map is made for it, and the map editor has a new Cannon object for Hide and Seek maps (poison on these maps knocks fighters out in War rounds).

updates.title: Party mode
updates.text: Party is a new mode in the main menu. Rounds take turns between three mini-games and a random round of other modes on a random map: a Quiz about the game with four answers, Guess the Word where one player draws and the rest type guesses, and Build Battle where everyone builds a model on a theme and rates the others with stars. The best player of each mini-game wins coins.

updates.title: Spy race maps
updates.text: Race maps can now be spy missions: grab the spy flag and carry it to the finish while security cameras sweep the rooms. If a camera sees you, you go back to the checkpoint, and a checkpoint keeps the flag safe. Walls and shelves block a camera's view, some cameras are hidden and only blink. A new Spy Base map shows it all, and the map editor has new Camera and Spy Flag objects for Race.

updates.title: Adventure mode
updates.text: Adventure is a new mode in the main menu that you can play alone or as a team against monsters. Pick a class in the lobby: the Warrior with a sword and the most health, the Archer with a long-range bow, or the Mage with fireballs and a heal. Rounds take turns between Bro Tower, where you clear five floors of slimes, skeletons, bats and knights to reach a crowned boss who slams the ground, and Crystal Defense, where waves of enemies march toward a crystal you have to protect. A victory pays coins to the whole team.

updates.title: Adventure on phones
updates.text: On phones the Adventure health bar now sits at the bottom between the controls, so it no longer covers your fighter.

updates.title: Game modes open on empty servers
updates.text: Murder Mystery, Team Battle and Party now have their own arena map, so you can enter them even when nobody has published a map yet.

updates.title: Modes on the test site
updates.text: All five new modes open on the test site and can be played alone against bots, including Murder Mystery and Team Battle.

updates.title: Matching character looks
updates.text: Bro RED, the Adventure classes and all Adventure enemies now look like the other characters: the same simple figure with small details, no glow.
